sentences: Meningitis is an infection of the protective membranes covering the brain and spinal cord, known as the meninges
This infection can be caused by various pathogens, including bacteria, viruses, and fungi
Bacterial meningitis is a life-threatening condition that can progress rapidly if left untreated
Neisseria meningitidis (meningococcus) is one of the most common causes of bacterial meningitis, which can result in septicemia and/or meningitis, with a high mortality rate if untreated
Symptoms of meningitis may include fever, headache, stiff neck, and confusion
In some cases, the infection may be mild or localized, which can lead to delays in diagnosis and treatment
The infection can affect anyone, regardless of age, and those traveling to areas with high rates of meningococcal disease, such as the meningitis belt in sub-Saharan Africa, are at an increased risk

The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) recommends vaccination against meningococcal disease, particularly for individuals traveling to areas with high transmission rates or for those with certain medical conditions
There are two types of meningococcal vaccines available in the United States: MenACWY and MenB, which provide protection against different serogroups of Neisseria meningitidis
